verdict.rationale: Proton Pass documents end-to-end encryption of every item field it stores, and it offers a PGP-encrypted export as a backup option. However, the pack never states that the vendor never holds the key, and it contains no published encryption design or whitepaper. Missing for 10: an explicit zero-knowledge statement that the vendor never holds the key, documented encryption design or architecture, a description of how backups or sync storage are encrypted, and independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a security engineer, backups are end-to-end encrypted with a key the vendor never holds, and the encryption design is documented

citations.quote: Proton Pass uses end-to-end encryption on every field you fill for the items you create (usernames, website addresses, and more).
A ZIP file containing a PGP-encrypted JSON file
